Adds **update channels**. Choose Stable or Beta on the System page: Stable installs (the default) are only offered stable releases, and Beta also offers betas such as 1.1.0, marked with a Beta badge. The installer installs the newest stable release unless you pass `--beta`.

Testing notes are in [testing-1.0.1.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.0.1/docs/testing-1.0.1.md).
